data: kacho.io BTC 5m per-second books 2026-03-24..05-18 + Binance BTCUSDT 1 s klines; A = market starts 03-24..04-25 UTC, B = 04-26..05-18
timing: decision d uses rows/klines stamped <= d-1; entry at the ask of the row stamped d+1, exit decided at e at the bid of the row stamped e+1; both legs pay 0.07 p (1-p); >= 5 shares, 0.02..0.98; one position per variant per market; forced exit at row 285; unsellable -> settled
selection: A: mean > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05 / N (N = all variants of families 1-7); B: of the k passing A, mean > 0 and p < 0.05 / k; >= 30 markets per split
